findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Inspector observed no ambient thermometers in the cold holding units (walk in cooler and prep coolers) at the facility. Ambient thermometers should be placed toward the warmest part of the cooling unit to ensure temperature control for food safety (TCS) food items are cold held at or below 41F. Obtain and place ambient thermometers by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(B) Temperature Measuring Devices. (B) Except as specified in (C) of this section, cold or hot holding EQUIPMENT used for TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. [C]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: No sanitizer solution was prepared in the cafe area. Inspector also noticed the sanitizer concentrate bag at the wall-mounted dispenser was nearly empty. PIC changed the concentrate bag and prepared sanitizer solution upon request. Sanitizer was observed at 400ppm quat. Ensure sanitizer is prepared prior to engaging in any food prep.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11 (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Spray bottle of sanitizer in the pizza prep area was at 0ppm quat. Another spray bottle prepared earlier in the day was observed at 200ppm. Spray bottle at 0ppm was discarded and replaced with fresh solution at 200ppm.
A quaternary ammonia compound solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. Use test strips to verify concentration. Ensure all spray bottles of sanitizer are checked with test strips to verify concentration and refreshed as needed prior to concentration becoming weak and ineffective.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14  Food employees were observed putting on gloves and going between glove changes without first washing hands. Proper handwashing and glove use were discussed. Employees were observed washing hands between tasks and glove changes for the remainder of the inspection.
Food Employees shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in food preparation including working with exposed food, clean equipment and utensils, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Hands must also be washed before putting on gloves/between glove changes and after engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: No bare hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed
findings.citation_text:
3-301.11 Employee was observed slicing pizza without wearing gloves. Company policy is to wear gloves during all food handling. Glove use was discussed, and gloves were worn for all food handling the remainder of the inspection.
Except when washing fruits and vegetables or when ingredients will be added to food that is being fully cooked/has a kill step for pathogens, food employees may not contact exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing equipment.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204-112 Thermometer could not be located in at least one of the prep coolers. Ensure that all cold holding units used for storage of TCS foods have a functioning thermometer for monitoring the temperature. 
Cold or hot holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - Shoot of ice machine & ice shoot of middle soda machine had some mold buildup on back surfaces. Clean & sanitize ice shoots daily/as needed to eliminate mold growth.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1210 Observed the interior plastic handle of the walk-in cooler to be damaged and broken. Repair the door handle. Also, the three compartment sink is not properly sealed to the wall. It appears the screws were removed and not replaced. The sink should be properly sealed to the wall. All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: 750-1060 Observed a plastic connection piece taped to the drainline of the 3-compartment sink in the cafe. Tape and attached portion of piping was removed during inspection. Tested the three compartment sink and no leaks were observed. Facility had no knowledge of why tape was in-place to begin. CORRECTED. All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.comment: 750-1280 Facility has two hooks mounted on the walls in the corner of the dry storage portion of the cafe. There was observed an additional winter coat on the single-service glove storage racks. Provide additional hooks for coat storage. Adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment: 750-280 Observed pizza cutters by the oven and beneath the hot display stored soiled and additional steamline dispensing tools stored within clean and specific container of sanitizer solution. During inspection, sanitizer solution was drained and utensils were stored in clean, dry container. Food handling utensils are currently being washed twice a day. Make sure the wash, rinse, and sanitizing of food handling utensils occurs at least every four hours. Increase frequency to at least three times daily. Disucss setting a standard policy with staff. Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: Open personal water is stored in prep top next to pan of pickles. 750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food. Water was discarded. Do not store employee food or drinks mixed with food for sale to the public.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: The tea machine spout is soiled with mold. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use and any time it may have become contaminated.  Properly wash rinse and sanitize food contact items and maintain clean.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: Black containers holding lids have some dust and soil. 750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination. Clean and keep clean.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment: 750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e. A wet wiping cloth is observed to be stored at the front counter not in sanitizer. These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, sanitized and air dried after each use. The mixing blades on the shake machine are not properly cleaned and sanitized between uses. Properly clean and sanitize this piece of equipment at proper intervals. (no more than 4 hours of continuous use)

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: 750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user. The single use soufflé cups and single use lids at fountain drinks are store in containers that have crumbs and dust in them. Clean out the holders regularly so that there is no sign of accumulated soil.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. The floor behind and around feet of the green rack in the kitchen is soiled. Clean the floors.
